links.outcome: accuracy and guideline compliance of DKD recommendations, and safety-critical errors (e.g., medication contraindications by renal function stage), rated by 12 blinded physicians
links.effect: RAG-enhanced system significantly outperformed unaugmented models on accurate, guideline-compliant recommendations and substantially reduced safety-critical errors; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.quote: Our evaluation reveals that the RAG-enhanced system significantly outperforms unaugmented models in providing accurate, guideline-compliant recommendations.
